name: GrayPass
long_description:
Login tells you who signed in. GrayPass helps apps check who’s behind sensitive actions and whether they’re authorized before those actions go through.

It combines identity, device and session context with behavioral signals like typing rhythm, cursor movement and scrolling. Before a sensitive action goes through, GrayPass evaluates that evidence against your team’s policy and returns a decision: allow, challenge, hold or deny. Your app enforces the decision.

This applies to actions like exporting sensitive data, changing admin permissions or allowing an AI agent to act on someone’s behalf. Allowed actions receive short-lived, signed proof tied to the exact action and your app.

Your existing login and authentication stack stays in place.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder/CEO at GrayPass (YC F26). University of Waterloo CS. Founded my first startup at 15 and raised $30K. Launched a fashion app that reached 3K users in 3 weeks and generated 1M+ views on social media. Served as the sole growth engineer at Stan ($40M ARR). At 16, developed dubbing and translation tools for creators including Logan Paul, Yes Theory and GothamChess. Now building GrayPass to help apps verify who's behind sensitive actions and whether they're authorized, even after login.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: Founder/COO @ GrayPass (YC F26) | Making human agency legible. Previously studied Neuroscience @ McGill. Conducted neurosurgical research at SickKids, with work published in Springer Nature. Granted a fellowship @ UBC to develop longitudinal transformer models predicting epilepsy outcomes from MRI scans. Founded an organization developing seizure-detection technology for epilepsy applications. Created brain tumour segmentation algorithms for UPenn BraTS challenges alongside EPFL researchers.
